record.question: Which of the following factors can reduce the oral bioavailability of a drug?
options: Giving the drug as an aqueous solution.
Reduction in size of the drug.
record.explanation: Answer A: First-pass metabolism in the liver.. First-pass metabolism can remove a fraction of an oral drug before it reaches systemic circulation, reducing bioavailability. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK557744/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
